title: CIA Dossier Depth Audit

maturity_definition.meaning_spine: Explains why the file matters, known material, interpretation, unknowns, relationship arc and confidence.
maturity_definition.event_ledger: Records sourced project events instead of automatic moral scoring.
maturity_definition.presence_bounds: Uses recovered first/last evidence windows when available.
maturity_definition.source_boundary: Keeps documentary, Chronicle, literary, project-symbolic and later synthesis layers distinct.

next_population_wave.reason: Complete meaning-spine coverage without padding thin files; emphasize source gaps where evidence is sparse.

later_population_wave.reason: Working/index files should be deepened only where chronology, source boundaries or recovery questions materially improve.

population_rules: Do not use byte size as a proxy for meaning.
A thin file may be complete if its strongest truth is that source material is missing.
Prefer dated scenes, phase changes, explicit unknowns and relationship arcs over trait accumulation.
Do not promote serious allegations from retrospective/profile prose without closer evidence.
Do not create symbolic debt or credit merely to make the account visually interesting.
